basePrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: one Expressly AAC communication card illustration. Input images: image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Match its clean friendly children's cartoon drawing, bold smooth black outlines, softly shaded flat colors, rounded simple shapes. New subject, not the train. Square composition, centered complete recognizable subject filling about 80 percent, generous white margins, pure white opaque background. No text, letters, logos, border, watermark, sparkles, faces on objects, decorative scenery, or people. Must remain immediately recognizable as a small communication symbol. Subject:
status: All 48 final images individually inspected; local only.
